# airlock_reference_baselines (Data Source)

List Airlock reference baselines available to import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "airlock_reference_baselines" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Filter by exact Airlock ID.
- `name` (String) Filter by exact Airlock name.

### Read-Only

- `first_id` (String) The first matching Airlock ID, useful when filtering by name.
- `items_json` (String) JSON array of matching objects returned by Airlock, with IDs, names, and non-sensitive attributes.
